question: Estimate the data centers needed in India to host all major cloud + OTT + e-commerce services for next 3 years.
idealClarificationQuestions: Total India-hosted compute capacity? Yes — DC capacity in MW.
Includes AWS, Azure, GCP, NTT, CtrlS, Yotta, AdaniConneX? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.description: Drivers: data localization mandates + AI workloads + OTT/e-commerce growth.

expectedLogicalStructure.description: India DC capacity 2026: ~1,400 MW (Mumbai + Chennai + Hyderabad lead).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: India will need ~2,500-3,000 MW of DC capacity (~80-100 large data centers) by 2029.
